description: This is a C# source file defining the class DelegateAsyncTimer which implements the IAsyncTimer interface. It provides an asynchronous timer mechanism with customizable tick behavior and health check method.

classes.name: DelegateAsyncTimer
classes.description: Implements a delegate-based asynchronous timer, allowing customizable tick behavior and health checks.

methods.name: NextTick
methods.description: Invokes the delegate to determine the next timer tick, returning a Task<bool>.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Performs a health check, always returning true and setting reason to default.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Increments the internal DisposedCounter, indicating disposal.
